universe.name: Nasdaq Composite proxy from PIT Nasdaq-listed monthly reports
universe.eligibilityPolicy: Use the workbook's PIT ETF flag to exclude ETFs. Also exclude obvious root-linked subordinate issue suffixes C/G/H/I/M/N/O/P/R/T/U/V/W/X/Z. Final QUQU-v2 eligibility additionally requires usable equity prices and capitalization data.
universe.selection: Top 10% by contemporaneous capitalization; FloatCap variants rank by float-adjusted cap proxy.

rules.legacyCore: sqrt(cap) × (relative 6-1 gross momentum)^3; 20% single-name cap; monthly rebalance
rules.momentum: P(signal month end) / P(allocation month - 6 month end) - 1; insufficient 6-1 history uses selected cross-sectional median gross momentum
rules.totalCap: Yahoo historical shares × raw close when available; otherwise split-safe current-share proxy × adjusted close
rules.floatCap: historical total cap × latest available Yahoo floatShares/sharesOutstanding ratio; missing ratio assumes 1.0 and is audited
rules.floatSelectionBuffer: Fetch float data for up to 5× target count by total-cap rank; verify kth float cap >= max total cap outside buffer
rules.volatility: 63-trading-day adjusted-close return standard deviation; adjusted excess momentum = excess × (cross-sectional median sigma / stock sigma)^0.25
rules.liquidity: Remove bottom 10% of FloatCap-selected holdings by trailing 63-trading-day median raw Close × Volume
rules.winsorization: Cross-sectional z-score of vol-adjusted excess momentum; clip z to ±3 and map back to excess-return units
rules.turnover: One-way monthly turnover = 0.5 × sum absolute difference between new target and prior successful target drifted by prior realized stock returns
rules.return: Adjusted first trading-day open to adjusted last observed close within allocation month; >2% missing-return weight rejects the whole month atomically

freeDataCaveat: Historical Nasdaq Public Float is a paid Fundamental Data field. This free-data study therefore uses a latest-float-ratio proxy, reports its coverage, and must not be labeled a fully point-in-time free-float backtest.

legacyQUQU.note: Existing Nasdaq-100 QUQU; separate benchmark because its universe differs from the v2 ablation universe.
